reddit.title: Exciting Updates on Water Mechanics in Provincia!
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how water interacts with the terrain in Provincia. Our new native sparse cellular automata (CA) keeps ponds affordable and efficient. You can now dig, raise, and manipulate terrain without freezing your game. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

steam.title: Water That Sees Dirt Edits - Major Improvements!
steam.body: We've revamped our water mechanics to make them more efficient and responsive. With the new native sparse CA, you can now manipulate the terrain without any freezing issues. This update ensures that water depth and terrain features work seamlessly together. Learn more about these changes in our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits
